mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recognition_queue_jobs (id, task_id, user_id, config_country, client, job_source, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{configCountry}, #{client}, #{jobSource}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, user_id, config_country, client, job_source, status, instance_id, created_at, started_at, completed_at FROM recognition_queue_jobs WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, task_id, user_id, config_country, client, job_source, status, instance_id, created_at, started_at, completed_at FROM recognition_queue_jobs WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recognition_queue_jobs WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('pending', 'running')
mapper.update: UPDATE recognition_queue_jobs SET status = 'running', instance_id = #{instanceId}, started_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recognition_queue_jobs WHERE status = 'pending'
mapper.update: UPDATE recognition_queue_jobs SET status = 'failed', completed_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'running' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{staleSeconds} SECOND)
